meta.title: Companies worth following
meta.note: Auto-tracked: the companies most active in the curated event log, each with its latest dated development. Machine-written from gated facts only; no hand-written copy.

companies.name: Vulcan Materials
companies.signal: The tribunal dismissed nearly all of the US company's claims except one, limiting the financial fallout for Mexico from a long-running dispute over a limestone quarry.

companies.name: Pemex
companies.signal: While major oil companies posted refining margins above $20 a barrel in 2024 and 2025, Mexico's state oil company lost money because of low profitability at its refineries.

companies.name: BMW
companies.signal: BMW will begin assembling its next-generation electric vehicles and batteries at its San Luis Potosí plant in 2027, part of a broader push by automakers to expand production capacity in the country.

companies.name: Walmart
companies.signal: The move follows a legal requirement for Mexican companies to reduce standard hours from 48 to 40, with a phase-in period beginning this year.

companies.name: First Majestic Silver
companies.signal: The Canadian miner will sell its inactive San Martin silver-gold mine to a private Mexican buyer under a deal with an upfront payment and deferred terms, closing out a dormant asset.

companies.name: CFE
companies.signal: Moody's cited stronger finances at CFE, which could make it easier for the utility to finance grid expansion.
